rules.title: Valid vendor and matching account
rules.text: The vendor exists in the master and is active; the NIF is in the master; the invoice IBAN matches the master's. Different IBAN -> fraud signal -> ESCALAR.

source_refs.quote: 1. Pagar solo si el NIF esta en el maestro y el IBAN de la factura coincide con el maestro.

rules.title: No duplicate payments
rules.text: Same invoice + same vendor -> NO_PAGAR (already paid / double submit). Same amount + same date -> NEEDS_REVIEW. The ERP state of the order must be PENDIENTE; PAGADA -> already paid -> NO_PAGAR.

source_refs.quote: 5. Estado ERP del pedido: PENDIENTE. Nunca pagar dos veces el mismo pedido.

rules.title: Amounts and VAT add up
rules.text: Line items sum to the base; VAT is correctly computed; total = base + VAT (±0.01); currency EUR; and the invoice amount matches the purchase-order amount (±0.01).

source_refs.quote: 2. El pedido debe existir, pertenecer al proveedor y el importe de la factura debe ser igual al del pedido (tolerancia 0,01 EUR).
3. El IVA debe estar bien calculado y el total debe ser base + IVA, con la misma tolerancia de 0,01 EUR.

rules.title: Amount-based authorization (threshold)
rules.text: Amount above a threshold -> requires human approval (ESCALAR). Our addition; OFF in the v3 norm profile.

rules.title: Valid dates within payment terms
rules.text: The date is valid and not in the future; and it falls within the vendor's payment terms (Condiciones, e.g. '60 dias').

source_refs.quote: 4. La fecha debe ser valida y no futura.

rules.title: Required fields present
rules.text: Missing required data (NIF / IBAN / PEDIDO / IMPORTE / IVA / FECHA) -> ESCALAR so a human can complete them.

source_refs.quote: 6. Cualquier anomalia que un humano deba ver: ESCALAR con motivo. Ante duda razonable, escalar antes que pagar.
